I didn’t know how to handle these endless moments of loneliness (combined with a and I just started to eat a lot as a coping mechanism: I ate 4-5 times a day, fast-food every week and an exaggerated amount of sweets and chocolate daily. WIBTA for telling me he’s a jerk and he should stop with this bullshit because it affects me? I know fat acceptance is a bullshit and you shouldn’t encourage someone to tolerate their harmful lifestyle, but it does affect me.
